## Why

In tools/discover_model_catalog.py lines 61-72, the parse_catalog function handles provider == "github-models" by filtering items with item.get("publisher") == "OpenAI". The GitHub Models catalog publishes models from multiple organizations (including Meta, Mistral AI, Microsoft, and Cohere). Filtering exclusively on publisher == "OpenAI" silently drops all non-OpenAI models from catalog discovery, blinding the repository catalog drift detection to newly available multi-provider models on GitHub Models.

## Scope

- Modify parse_catalog in tools/discover_model_catalog.py to support all valid catalog models regardless of publisher or allow configurable publisher filtering.
- Add unit test coverage in tests/tools/test_discover_model_catalog.py verifying non-OpenAI publishers on GitHub Models are parsed.

## Non-Goals

- Changing API endpoints or headers used in tools/discover_model_catalog.py.
- Automatically promoting unreviewed catalog models into config/model_registry.json.
- Scaffold-only completion does NOT count: removing publisher validation without preserving id and capability checks is a failure of this issue.

## Tasks

- [ ] Update parse_catalog in tools/discover_model_catalog.py to accept models from all publishers on GitHub Models
- [ ] Add unit tests in tests/tools/test_discover_model_catalog.py covering multi-publisher GitHub Models catalog payloads

## Acceptance Criteria

- `python tools/discover_model_catalog.py` parses multi-publisher catalog entries without error.
- `pytest tests/tools/test_discover_model_catalog.py` passes all test cases.
- Deliberate-break demonstration: restoring the strict OpenAI publisher check causes `pytest tests/tools/test_discover_model_catalog.py` to fail on multi-publisher fixtures, and reverting restores pass.

## Implementation Notes

References: Code/Audits/Ready/2026-09-07-00-repo-map.md.
Preserve CatalogModel dataclass fields and timestamp parsing logic.


Transferred from Ready #558 because `.github/sync-manifest.yml` centrally manages `tools/discover_model_catalog.py`. Implement in Workflows first; the managed consumer-sync campaign delivers the source fix to Ready. The test path above now points to the existing Workflows catalog suite. The CLI returns 1 for reported drift, which is expected; parsing errors must not occur. Validation and deliberate-break evidence will be recorded in the implementation PR.
